sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "muscle_group" TEXT NOT NULL, "tracking_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "load_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "per_side" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("per_side" IN (0, 1)), "per_dumbbell" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("per_dumbbell" IN (0, 1)), "secondary_muscles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_folders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_collapsed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_collapsed" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_templates" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "folder_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES template_folders (id) ON DELETE SET NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "template_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_templates (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "reps_min" INTEGER NULL, "reps_max" INTEGER NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "target_weight_kg" REAL NULL, "superset_group" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workouts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "template_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES workout_templates (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "bodyweight_kg" REAL NULL, "total_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_volume_kg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "exercise_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "note" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_reps_min" INTEGER NULL, "target_reps_max" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "superset_group" INTEGER NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "target_weight_kg" REAL NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "workout_exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "load_kg" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "set_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal', "rpe" REAL NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "distance_m" REAL NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "weight_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg', "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "pure_black" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pure_black" IN (0, 1)), "bodyweight_kg" REAL NULL, "default_rest_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 90, "auto_start_rest" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_start_rest" IN (0, 1)), "rest_alerts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("rest_alerts" IN (0, 1)), "keep_screen_on" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("keep_screen_on" IN (0, 1)), "permissions_prompted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("permissions_prompted" IN (0, 1)), "weekly_goal" INTEGER NULL, "effort_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'off', "rest_sound" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("rest_sound" IN (0, 1)), "first_day_of_week" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "bar_weight_kg" REAL NULL, "plates" TEXT NULL, "balance_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "balance_max" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, "last_backup_at" INTEGER NULL, "backup_snoozed_at" INTEGER NULL, "app_lock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("app_lock" IN (0, 1)), "dynamic_color" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dynamic_color" IN (0, 1)), "reminder_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reminder_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1080, "set_menu_hint_seen" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("set_menu_hint_seen" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rest_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "ends_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bodyweight_entries" ("date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kg" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "progress_photos" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "taken_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_exercises_archived ON exercises (is_archived)
CREATE INDEX idx_workout_templates_folder ON workout_templates (folder_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_template_exercises_template ON template_exercises (template_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_template_exercises_exercise ON template_exercises (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_workouts_template ON workouts (template_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_workouts_ended ON workouts (ended_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_workouts_started ON workouts (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_workout_exercises_workout ON workout_exercises (workout_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_workout_exercises_exercise ON workout_exercises (exercise_id)
